A '''Klatooinian''' was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]] belonging to [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is terrible, Captain! Noggox will be livid!''"<br />"''Relax Lieutenant. We weren't carrying anything illegal, the freighter was ''insured''&mdash;and Noggox told me ''exactly'' what to do if we were raided by pirates. Transmit an emergency distress signal to Coruscant!|A Lieutenant to the captain|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was owned by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was carrying [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] to the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] when it was intercepted near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] by a [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class pirate ship|pirate ship]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]] contacted the Captain and ordered his surrender and sent [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to capture the freighter, though the Captain warned him that the ship was owned by Noggox. Pundar allowed the crew to take refuge in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. As Pundar absconded with their freighter a [[Unidentified Snivvian Lieutenant|lieutenant]] voiced his concerns to the Captain, who ordered him to transmit a distress signal to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He and the crew were later recovered safely.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Captain appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
